decision.question: To what extent has the image been transformed from the source into a pencil drawing?
decision.criteria: Pass only if the scene as a whole convincingly reads as a pencil drawing, with pencil-like strokes, outlines, and drawn shading replacing the photographic rendering. Fail if there is no visible change toward a pencil-drawn rendering. Partial if there is visible drawing-like transformation but it is incomplete or weak, with substantial photographic appearance remaining; desaturation or grain alone does not establish completion, but count as partial progress when accompanied by actual drawing-like changes. Unknown only if visual evidence is insufficient to judge.
decision.binding: Compare the source and edited images for fulfillment of the requested pencil-drawing transformation. Assess the scene as a whole: distinguish no visible requested progress from incomplete drawing-like progress and convincing completion. Do not treat monochrome or grain alone as complete fulfillment.
